summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 5 (message edit and cascade): a new shared cascade module (src/domains/messages/internal/cascade.ts) derives the clear-set structurally from the message → turn → chunk walk over existing derived_form rows, supersede-deletes still-queued old-version items (reported on the result), and enqueues replacements at each group's max source version + 1 inside the mutation's transaction. messages.edit validates through the deleted-filtered read (turn_open / message_not_found refusals), applies content + blocks + token re-stamp via new store.ts helpers (readMutableMessage / applyMessageEdit mirroring projectEvent's counted fields), runs the cascade, and returns the MutationResult — one synchronous commit, with enqueue pokes riding onCommit so background mode rebuilds with no further call. The source-version check (existing single write path in work-queue complete()) is provoked by TC-5.4's delayed-double recipe: a real claimed pre-edit item held across the edit completes after the post-edit replacement is queued and discards as stale_discarded. CLI: new src/cli/messages-mutate.ts and `lhc messages edit --message/--message-id --content` wiring with parity proven through the spawned binary.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead is pausing for caller ruling 05-message-edit-cascade-story-run-001-ruling-spec-deviation before impl-lead can accept the story.
